project: Automatos AI Platform — PRD-154 Wave-0 Quick Wins (Remediation Chain Night 1, first)
description: Twelve independent stories fixing verified one-to-three-file breakages from the platform deep review (reports/PLATFORM_DEEP_REVIEW_2026-06.md §2; full spec docs/PRDS/PRD-154-WAVE0-QUICK-WINS.md with BINDING amendments). Branch from main. Rules: no shims, delete what you replace, no new tables/tools, no os.getenv outside config.py, no hardcoded values. Update tests that assert the old broken behavior — never skip/delete them. Chain testing policy: docs/PRDS/PRD-CHAIN-2026-06-REMEDIATION.md.

userStories.title: RAG: batched full-chunk hydration consumed by the formatter
userStories.description: modules/rag/service.py:855-909 already hydrates full chunk text into candidate['expanded_content'] via one asyncpg query PER candidate, and NOTHING reads it — service.py:544 and :754 read only c['content'] (the 500-char S3 metadata preview written by ingestion/manager.py:1300). Replace the N+1 with ONE batched IN-query over parent chunk ids, and make the retrieval/format path consume the hydrated text so result_formatter.py's 4000-char per-doc budget (:354-356) actually fills. Do not change chunking or S3 writes.
acceptanceCriteria: DONE — _expand_to_parent_context joins (doc_id,chunk_index) keys against document_chunks via unnest; read-sites service.py:545 & :756 now consume expanded_content. test_hydration_is_a_single_batched_query + consume tests assert hydrated text >500 chars reaches chunks.
DONE — single unnest($1::int[],$2::int[]) round-trip replaces the N+1; test asserts conn.fetch.await_count == 1 for 3 candidates across 2 docs.

DONE — added tests/test_rag_hydration.py (4 tests: batched-query, fallback-to-preview, basic_retrieval consume, optimizer consume). No existing formatter test asserted the old 500-char truncation (4000-char budget already shipped PRD-136 in modules/tools/formatting/result_formatter.py:356), so none required updating; story files path 'modules/rag/result_formatter.py' was stale.
DONE — cd orchestrator && pytest -q: 2061 passed, 16 skipped, 1 xfailed.

userStories.title: RAG: team filter fails closed; fix team-access PATCH SQL
userStories.description: service.py:391-393 except-branch returns ALL candidates unfiltered on DB error (fail-open security hole). Fail closed: on filter error return only candidates with empty team_access (public) and log error-level. Separately, api/documents.py:1871-1924 PATCH/bulk team-access SQL references documents.title and documents.updated_at which DO NOT EXIST in the model (core/models/core.py:548-580) — fix the SQL to the real columns (BINDING Q1: fail-closed).

DONE — PATCH & bulk SQL fixed to real columns: dropped phantom 'updated_at = NOW()', RETURNING/response use 'filename' (Document has no title/updated_at). test_team_access_sql_targets_real_columns (deterministic, model-introspection + source guard) + @integration test_team_access_endpoints_execute_against_real_schema (runs the real endpoint SQL against CI Postgres; bogus ids -> 404/updated:0, proving every column plans against the live schema; skips with no DB).

userStories.title: Memory: infer:false for curated writes, real bulk delete, week-scale decay, touch-on-recall
userStories.description: Four root causes of memory junk/loss (report §2.2): (1) curated writers (distilled facts, mission/playbook/widget/tool stores via mem0_client.py:312-376) omit infer so mem0 re-extracts them with its personal-info prompt — send infer:false on every already-curated write. (2) mem0_client.py:498-506 calls DELETE /api/v1/memories/{id}/ which doesn't exist on the server (only bulk DELETE per mem0_openapi.json) — every delete 405s and trips the circuit breaker; switch to the bulk endpoint. (3) MEMORY_DECAY_RATE=0.1/hr + threshold 0.3 (config.py:104,106) archives importance-0.8 memories in ~15h — retune to week-scale via config. (4) touch_short_term has ZERO callers so L2→L3 promotion (unified_memory_service.py:1990-1996) can never fire — call it on recall.
acceptanceCriteria: Grep-able assertion test: all curated write paths pass infer:false
Delete uses bulk endpoint; circuit-breaker no longer trips on 3 consecutive deletes (test)
Decay unit test: importance-0.8 L2 row survives >= 7 days
Recall increments access_count (promotion-eligibility test)
Existing decay/memory tests updated to new constants; cd orchestrator && pytest -q green

Call it from create-with-assignee and the assign endpoint; guard double-fire for already-running tasks and skip recipe-mirror tasks. Also fix the broken priority CASE expression in services/heartbeat_service.py:919. PRD-09 constraint: do NOT touch shared hybrid auth or test_board_sdk_auth.py behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration test (mock executor): assign → execution starts same tick
